technical_quality: Adequate penetration, no significant rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), apices and both costophrenic angles included. Mild under-inspiration with elevated hemidiaphragms (~6 anterior ribs), which somewhat exaggerates cardiac size and basal crowding. L side marker present over the left shoulder, confirming conventional orientation.

devices.location: Projected over the patient's left acromion / shoulder, upper right corner of the image

abnormalities.finding: Reticulonodular / patchy peribronchial infiltrate extending from below the right hilum along the right heart border to the medial base (labelled finding)
Increased perihilar bronchovascular markings without discrete consolidation, more prominent on the right
Borderline cardiomegaly (CTR approximately 0.55-0.57), partly exaggerated by shallow inspiration
Prominent / unfolded tortuous aortic arch, consistent with age-related aortic ectasia
Bilateral glenohumeral degenerative change with superior migration of the humeral heads (rotator cuff arthropathy pattern), right more than left
Elevated hemidiaphragms with basal crowding from under-inspiration; costophrenic angles sharp, no pleural effusion or pneumothorax

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，左肩處可見 L 側標記，患者吸氣略不足、兩側橫膈位置偏高。右下肺野內側（右肺門下方沿右心緣至右側橫膈上方）可見網狀結節狀及斑片狀浸潤陰影，範圍約 7 公分；雙側肺門周圍支氣管血管紋理增加，但未見明確實質化或肋膈角鈍化。心影略增大（心胸比約 0.55），主動脈弓突出迂曲，氣管居中。雙側肩關節退化性變化併肱骨頭上移（右側較明顯），未見任何管路、引流裝置或節律器。
